issues.jp_before: この古[ふる]いペン{は|wa-topic}黒[くろ]{しか|shika-nai}書[か]けません。
issues.problem: 黒しか書けません is unnatural; a colour of writing needs で (黒でしか書けない), and an 'old pen' that writes only black is an odd premise.
issues.action: Rewrote as このプリンター{は}白黒{で|de-means}{しか}印刷できません (f=2, d=だけ/も/さえ, lv 3) with matching English and why.

issues.jp_before: この地図[ちず]{は|wa-topic}大[おお]きい道[みち]{しか|shika-nai}書[か]いてありません。
issues.problem: With 書いてある the map is the location of the writing; この地図には is the natural form, plain は is marked. The why also wrongly called the map-roads phrase 'the subject' focus.
issues.action: Changed to この地図{に|ni-location}{は|wa-topic}…, moved f from 1 to 2, and corrected the why.
